meta.source: F:/GitHub/DronePhotography src/styles/global.css + Brand Assets.dc.html (card, badge, signature) + stinger artifact GQ8RFS3WLe6czvXcfX8R14
meta.units: Screen values in CSS px. Print values in in/pt. Lockup values are ratios of S, the font size of the 'Three Rivers' line.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Point Black. The one brand black: site page ground, business card and badge ground, QR dark modules, headings and names on cream. Absorbs the lightbox's rgba(6,6,8) and every other near-black.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface on black: contact and portfolio bands, badge photo well. Never text.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Cards on black (pricing, services, form). Never text.

tokens.name: ink-600
tokens.usage: Borders and dividers on black (card edges, footer rule, badge rules). Absorbs the badge's one-off #2c2c34.

tokens.name: gold-400
tokens.usage: Hover gold and focus ring on black (11.7:1 on ink-900). Pill text on the card back. Light end of the gold gradient.

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Primary gold on black: the mark, AERIAL CO., links, kicker, buttons (9.4:1 on ink-900). On cream it is 1.86:1, so use it only for the decorative signature divider; never for text or the mark.

tokens.name: gold-600
tokens.usage: Deep gold: the short rule under the lockup, kicker rule, T/E/W labels on black (5.75:1). On cream (3.05:1) use it only for the mark, rules, and text 24px+ (or 19px+ bold).

tokens.name: gold-700
tokens.usage: Added. Gold text under 24px on cream (4.96:1): signature title line, AERIAL CO. on cream, invoice labels, links on cream.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Headings and names on black (17.5:1). Paper colour for the signature, letterhead, and invoice. QR light modules.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Body text on black (9.6:1 on ink-900, 8.6:1 on ink-700).

tokens.name: stone-dim
tokens.usage: Muted text on ink-900/ink-800 only (4.61:1 / 4.42:1, so 4.42 fails AA below 18.66px bold; keep it to 14px+ there). Fails on ink-700 (4.16:1) and on cream (3.81:1).

tokens.name: stone-700
tokens.usage: Added. Muted text on cream (6.0:1): signature credential line, letterhead footer, invoice meta.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Added. Body text on cream (10.4:1). Warm replacement for the signature's neutral #3a3a3a.

tokens.name: gold-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline frame inside the business card front (1px). Decorative only.

tokens.name: gold-border
tokens.usage: Credential pill border on black.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Nav bar bottom border and mobile menu rule on black.

tokens.name: gold-glow
tokens.usage: Inner stop of the corner glow (radial, to transparent at 70%). Card back uses 0.10, video uses 0.13. Screen and video only; never on print.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page or artboard ground.

tokens.name: text-heading
tokens.usage: Headings, names, the 'Three Rivers' line, on ground.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: Body copy and contact details, on ground.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Taglines, credential lines, captions, on ground.

tokens.name: text-gold
tokens.usage: Small gold text: AERIAL CO., role and title lines, kickers, links, on ground.

tokens.name: mark-color
tokens.usage: The three-river mark and gold text 24px+, on ground.

tokens.name: rule-color
tokens.usage: The short gold rule and kicker rule.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and table rules, on ground.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: Hairline frame inside print pieces and social posts.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a gold-500 fill (buttons, badge strip, gold-ground logo): 9.4:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline, 3px offset, on every focusable element.

tokens.name: guide
tokens.usage: Trim and safe-zone guide lines in template previews only. Never printed or exported.

groups.name: Logo
groups.note: Logo text is outlined in the SVGs. These styles exist so live-text uses (stinger, HTML artboards) match. Always fix Fraunces at opsz 29 with font-optical-sizing:none.

styles.name: logo-name
styles.usage: The 'Three Rivers' line in every lockup. S = this size; scale everything else from it.

styles.name: logo-sub-primary
styles.usage: AERIAL CO. in the primary stacked lockup: 0.379 S, uppercase.

styles.name: logo-sub-secondary
styles.usage: AERIAL CO. in the secondary horizontal lockup: 0.583 S (S = 19.2px in the nav), uppercase.

groups.name: Screen
groups.note: From global.css. Fraunces 500 for headings, Inter for everything else.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Pittsburgh real estate, seen from a higher point.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Cinematic aerial photography and videography for residential and commercial properties.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every flight is FAA Part 107 certified with airspace clearance handled before takeoff.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Gold label above headlines, preceded by a 40px gold-600 rule.

groups.name: Print
groups.note: Physical sizes. Floors: 6pt for any text, 5pt only for tracked uppercase labels.

styles.name: print-name
styles.usage: Person's name on the card back and badge.

styles.name: print-body
styles.sample: Thank you for flying with Three Rivers Aerial Co.

styles.name: print-role
styles.usage: Role line under a name, uppercase, text-gold.

styles.name: print-label
styles.usage: Pills, T/E/W labels, QR caption. Uppercase only.

groups.name: Email
groups.note: Fraunces and Inter will not load in most mail clients. Set the brand face first and the fallback right after, so the fallback is what nearly everyone sees.

styles.name: email-name
styles.usage: Signature name. Georgia bold stands in for Fraunces 600.

styles.name: email-title
styles.sample: FOUNDER & LEAD PILOT · THREE RIVERS AERIAL CO.

styles.name: email-meta
styles.sample: FAA PART 107 CERTIFIED · SERVING GREATER PITTSBURGH

styles.name: video-role
styles.usage: Lower-third role and stinger tagline, uppercase.

spacing.note: Screen spacing in px. The site writes these in rem (1rem = 16px).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight inline gaps (pill dot to text).

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Contact row gaps, label to value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Kicker rule gap, small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button groups, hairline frame inset on the 525px card preview.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stack items on the card front.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gaps between cards (1.5rem).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding (2rem), card back padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Card padding top/bottom (2.5rem).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Heading to grid (3rem).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Column gap in two-column sections (4rem).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Section padding: clamp(4.5rem, 9vw, 7.5rem).

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Printed trim edges (cards, letterhead) unless die-cut.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, badges ('Most Popular').

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: The hairline frame inside the card front.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Cards, portfolio tiles, QR plate.

tokens.name: radius-3
tokens.usage: Badge photo, favicon tile (8 of 64).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Credential pill, lanyard slot.

tokens.name: shadow-gold-hover
tokens.usage: Gold button hover.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-field
tokens.usage: Focused input.

tokens.name: shadow-artboard
tokens.usage: Presentation only, when showing a card or badge mockup. Never printed.

lockup.note: Unitless ratios of S (the 'Three Rivers' font size) unless marked em. Measured from the business card (S = 29px) and Logo.astro (S = 19.2px).

tokens.name: name-opsz
tokens.usage: Fraunces optical size for the 'Three Rivers' line at every scale.

tokens.name: name-tracking
tokens.usage: 'Three Rivers' letter-spacing, both lockups.

tokens.name: primary-mark
tokens.usage: Mark box height (72 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-mark-to-name-baseline
tokens.usage: Mark box bottom to the 'Three Rivers' baseline (45 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-name-to-sub-baseline
tokens.usage: Baseline to baseline (22 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-sub-size
tokens.usage: AERIAL CO. size (11 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-sub-tracking
tokens.usage: AERIAL CO. tracking in the primary lockup. Center on the ink: drop the trailing tracking.

tokens.name: primary-sub-to-rule
tokens.usage: AERIAL CO. baseline to rule top (23 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-rule-width
tokens.usage: Rule width (38 / 29).

tokens.name: primary-rule-weight
tokens.usage: Rule thickness (1 / 29); never under 1 device pixel or 0.25pt.

tokens.name: secondary-mark
tokens.usage: Mark box height (34 / 19.2).

tokens.name: secondary-gap
tokens.usage: Mark box to text (11.2 / 19.2).

tokens.name: secondary-name-baseline
tokens.usage: Mark top to 'Three Rivers' baseline (17.28 / 19.2).

tokens.name: secondary-sub-baseline
tokens.usage: Mark top to AERIAL CO. baseline (31.39 / 19.2).

tokens.name: secondary-sub-size
tokens.usage: AERIAL CO. size (11.2 / 19.2).

tokens.name: secondary-sub-tracking
tokens.usage: AERIAL CO. tracking in the secondary lockup.

tokens.name: clearspace
tokens.usage: Minimum clear space on every side, as a multiple of the mark box height.

tokens.name: mark-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke width in the 64-unit viewBox (1/16 of the mark), round caps.

tokens.name: bleed
tokens.usage: Bleed on every printed piece.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: Keep text and the hairline frame at least this far inside the trim.

tokens.name: card-w
tokens.usage: Business card trim width (3.75in with bleed).

tokens.name: card-h
tokens.usage: Business card trim height (2.25in with bleed).

tokens.name: badge-w
tokens.usage: CR80 badge, portrait trim width.

tokens.name: badge-h
tokens.usage: CR80 badge, portrait trim height.

tokens.name: badge-corner
tokens.usage: CR80 standard corner radius.

tokens.name: letter-margin
tokens.usage: Letterhead and invoice side margins (US Letter).

tokens.name: qr-size
tokens.usage: QR plate on the card back, quiet zone included. Encode https://threeriversaerial.com, error correction M.

tokens.name: ease-rise
tokens.usage: Expo out. Text rising out of a mask, the rule wiping out, anything entering.

tokens.name: ease-draw
tokens.usage: River strokes drawing in (stinger and all video).

tokens.name: ease-draw-web
tokens.usage: Legacy: the nav logo draw in Logo.astro. Move it to ease-draw when the site is next updated.

tokens.name: ease-ui
tokens.usage: Hover and color transitions on the site.

tokens.name: dur-stinger
tokens.usage: Full stinger, including the exit.

tokens.name: dur-river
tokens.usage: Allegheny and Monongahela draw in the stinger.

tokens.name: dur-ohio

tokens.name: dur-rise
tokens.usage: Name and sub-line rise in the stinger.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Stinger fade and 2.5% zoom out.
